Employer -  Hidrive Group Pty Ltd


Position  : Full Time 
Location : Goulburn NSW
Salary     : $75,000 - $85,000 a year


Hidrive designs, manufactures and installs light, strong, fit-for-purpose service bodies for utes, trailers, and trucks — trusted by trades, industry and governments since 1993. Hidrive is Australia’s only service body manufacturer with a company-owned national installation network, and it designs, builds and installs fit-for-purpose service bodies for all trades and industries at our company-owned facilities in Adelaide, Brisbane, Goulburn, Melbourne, Perth and Sydney.

Hidrive is currently looking for hardworking and dedicated Fitter to join their team.


You should have the skills to:
Accurately read and interpret drawings and specifications.
Operate machines to produce parts by turning, boring, milling, shaping, slotting, grinding or drilling metal stock or components.
Fabrication of all types of steel, aluminium and stainless-steel structures
Plate Profiling, Machining and Lathe jobs
Welding and insulation work
Order/fabricate with accuracy and assemble metal parts.
Assist in equipment maintenance, repair, upgrades and installations.
Perform scheduled inspections and condition assessment on machines.
Maintaining appropriate stock levels of spare parts
Complete tasks to high quality while working to a deadline.

Skills and Experience:
Relevant trade qualification
At least 2 years work experience
Have a strong adherence OH&S and in keeping as safe workplace.
Willing to follow detail instructions to and quick Learner.
Be able to perform the physical requirements of the role.


If you think you have got the skills and experience to join our team, please apply now. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

result.description:
About the Role
We are seeking a skilled and experienced Automotive Technician to join our team in Victoria. In this full-time role, you will diagnose, repair and maintain a wide range
of vehicles while helping us deliver efficient, high-quality service to our customers.

What We’re Looking For
-Trade qualification in Automotive.
-Strong diagnostic skills and experience with general servicing, fault diagnosis
and repairs across a variety of vehicles.
-Experience with suspension, brake repairs, tyre fitting, balancing and wheel
alignment.
-Air conditioning service and re-gassing experience is desirable, but not
essential; training can be provided.
-Ability to work confidently in a busy, fast-paced workshop on all makes and
models, including 4WDs, SUVs and European vehicles.
-Excellent communication skills, attention to detail and a high standard of
customer care.
- Ability to work unsupervised, maintain a strong work ethic and contribute
positively to the team.
- Current driver’s licence.
-Punctual, professional presentation and a safe, environmentally responsible
approach to work.
